scope: Exploratory Linux local two-view integration; not product acceptance
schema: src/schema.mjs; minimal R02-derived semantic subset, not canonical Clutter schema

profiles.raw: Unpatched pinned ProseMirror libraries; guard disabled explicitly in diagnostic test only
profiles.guarded: Default Context plus conservative history-guard.mjs; refuses foreign deletion/opaque overlap
profiles.control: One raw editor, same schema/fixture/table command; no authority/collab/backup
plugins: collab with explicit context origin and current version
profiles.keymap: src/browser.mjs; Mod-z / Mod-Shift-z / Mod-y, Mod-b; Q-04 exploratory nextCellOrRow; Shift-Tab previous cell

histories: Per editing context, preserved across view detach; not persisted across host restart. Foreign accepted steps rebased via pinned collab plugin. Guard is an experiment, not accepted selective undo design.
representations: Authority accepted doc; immutable engine caches/provisional input in contexts; snapshot/recovery records deliberately serialize protected copies.
persistence: MemoryStore in tests, browser-only localStorage in UI, FileStore separate headless processes; never production app/vault. Node snapshot uses fsync/rename and directory fsync, not power-loss qualification.
adapters: CLI and MCP share execute(); headless disk adapters serialize by fail-closed lab lock. They do not connect to the browser authority. No general IPC/grants/takeover implemented.
unsupported: task page projection and full task move/copy/delete/recurrence commands
qualification: blocked; see findings.md and committed evidence. npm test includes a passing diagnostic that confirms an unsafe raw-candidate result, not an acceptance pass.
